Own 2.4-h box 1972 +/- 158 ppm (empirical); at the pipeline's exact ephemeris and 2.25-h box 2099 ppm; median/trimmed/weighted/core definitions 1726-2194 ppm; maximum over box widths 0.5-6 h 2273 ppm; astropy BLS fitted depth 1444 ppm; trapezoid bottom 2293 ppm. The pipeline's own event-weighted depth (1519 ppm) and quartile depths (1112-1980 ppm) agree with this re-derivation, not with its 3034-ppm headline; the only pipeline statistic near 3034 is the TLS model depth (3007 ppm).
empirical SNR 12.5 (random-phase boxes) vs 9.85 (pipeline box noise): same sign, different noise estimator
SAP vs PSF: SAP depth 677 +/- 49 ppm, ratio 0.34 +/- 0.04 against 0.80-0.97 expected from header CROWDSAP for an undiluted on-target signal; vet.json contains no SAP check

per-season (same module every 4th quarter) depths are inconsistent: PSF 3925/1960/1417/1129 ppm (chi2 18/3), SAP 474/309/1446/383 ppm (chi2 75/3); SAP/PSF is 1.02 on module 8 but 0.12-0.34 elsewhere; the pipeline's per-quartile test (time quartiles mixing all seasons) cannot see this

dilution bookkeeping: raw per-quarter PSF-fit flux of the target is 351-2604 e/s (0.25x-1.9x the ~1400 e/s expected for Kp 17.2) and raw SAP aperture flux 2000-7370 e/s (1.4-5.3x expected), module-dependent; the CSV psffrac 0.52 / crowdsap 0.80 used downstream are not trustworthy for this source

radius if on target: 4.3 Re from the 1972-ppm PSF box depth vs pipeline 5.28 Re (box) / 4.73 Re (TLS); season- and photometry-dependent estimates span ~1000-3400 ppm (3-5.5 Re), so no single radius is defensible

the G=20.5 Gaia source 3.6 arcsec (~0.9 px) from the target is not in the KBONUS source catalogue (unmodelled) and has no light curve to test; the pipeline pixel deficit is nearest to it in 4 of 14 quarters and to the target in only 2; this re-derivation cannot exclude it as the host (a ~3-4% V-shaped eclipse on it would reproduce the signal)

blind recovery is detrend-dependent: with a plain 1-d running median (no step splitting) the periodogram is dominated by Q2/Q6 step discontinuities (top peak 45.85 d, SDE 7.7) and 12.97 d ranks ~60th; it is the top peak only after splitting detrend segments at detected steps
comparison_with_pipeline.verdict: A periodic 12.972-d box-shaped deficit is unambiguously present in both PSF and aperture photometry of this source (independent SNR 12.5 and 13.8), with no odd/even or secondary signature; but its fractional depth is not a stable quantity for this star (factor 3-10 between photometries and seasons), the pipeline's 3034 ppm is not reproduced (own value ~2000 ppm), and the deficit cannot be assigned to the target rather than an unmodelled G=20.5 neighbour 0.9 px away. Candidate-language only; depth and radius should be quoted as ranges until pixel-level work resolves the host.
